loop: Fix the stretched solar system on the Void Drift title screen
worked: I confirmed the bug in Chromium at 4:3 before editing: a 1920×1080 drawing was stretched into a 1024×768 canvas box.
Putting the fixed-aspect presentation in the shared backdrop kept the sky and scrim full-size and left the adaptive flight canvas alone.

I inspected 4:3 and ultrawide title captures and the canonical Lab example, checked the Settings and Top Scores backdrop layouts, and confirmed Press Start transitioned into flight at 4:3. Lint and the focused spec check passed.

issues.observation: The focused Playwright suite asked Astro to start on port 4322. Astro reported an existing dev server on port 4321 and exited before the suite ran.
issues.effect: The suite did not run in this loop. I used direct Chromium checks against the shared preview for the backdrop and launch handoff instead.
issues.interpretation: Astro’s same-checkout dev-server detection appears to have blocked the second server despite the separate port. I did not test other checkout configurations.

issues.observation: The backdrop spec contained agent-attributed verification entries that the current spec checker rejected.
issues.effect: I cleared those entries without adding a human verification claim; the focused spec check then passed.
issues.interpretation: The actor names in the existing entries did not meet the current checker’s human-attribution rule.
